THE_ARCHITECT.talk.JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA: A mage. The Tower has not seen true magic in a long while.
This Tower... as if cast from a nightmare by some will. Are you its prisoner too?
Prisoner? No. I am its architect. And you are my unfinished work.
Your frost seeps into the Tower's foundations. Curious. Little makes the Tower tremble.
It is not the Tower that trembles, but the souls within it that refuse to rest.
Souls are but building materials. Like your ice, merely a stroke on my blueprints.
Mage, you stand before the final door. Answer me — what have you built?
I built protection. The sea winds of Kul Tiras, the lanterns of Theramore, and... every spell I have ever written.
Then prove it with your protection. The Tower will remember your name.
